Follow-up or referral options are discussed according to your situation.

detartrage-polissage-questions.title: Scaling and polishing: questions to ask
detartrage-polissage-questions.excerpt: What is a dental hygiene appointment for, and how can you discuss it with your practitioner?
detartrage-polissage-questions.author: Cabinet Sourire Serein team
detartrage-polissage-questions.imageAlt: Illustration of a dental hygiene appointment.
detartrage-polissage-questions.content:
## Talk about your habits and expectations
During your appointment, tell the dental professional about sensitive areas, any bleeding and care you have already received. This information helps the professional tailor the examination and advice to your situation.

## Care is considered after an assessment
The professional explains whether scaling or polishing is appropriate and answers your questions about what the visit may involve. Follow-up frequency depends on an individual assessment and is not the same for everyone.

## After your appointment
Ask for oral care advice suited to your teeth and gums. If pain persists or you notice an unusual symptom after care, contact the practice for advice.

grossesse-sante-bucco-dentaire.title: Pregnancy and dental care: talk with your practitioner
grossesse-sante-bucco-dentaire.excerpt: Why it is useful to mention pregnancy and ask for advice before dental care or medication.
grossesse-sante-bucco-dentaire.author: Cabinet Sourire Serein team
grossesse-sante-bucco-dentaire.imageAlt: Illustration of a patient discussing dental care during pregnancy.
grossesse-sante-bucco-dentaire.content:
## Mention your pregnancy from the first conversation
If you are pregnant or think you may be, tell the professional before an examination, treatment or medication. If you know it, mention how far along you are and any advice you have received from your maternity care team.

## Ask for advice suited to your situation
The timing and arrangements for care depend on its urgency, your health and the clinical assessment. If useful, the practitioner may discuss your care with your maternity professional.

## Do not wait for advice if a concern feels urgent
If you have pain, swelling or another worrying symptom, contact a health professional to ask what to do. This article provides general information and does not replace personalised advice.

kinesitherapie-maxillo-faciale-informati.title: Maxillofacial physiotherapy: when to ask for advice
kinesitherapie-maxillo-faciale-informati.excerpt: A few points to help you prepare a conversation about your jaw and its function.
kinesitherapie-maxillo-faciale-informati.author: Cabinet Sourire Serein team
kinesitherapie-maxillo-faciale-informati.imageAlt: Illustration of a patient discussing jaw and facial function.
kinesitherapie-maxillo-faciale-informati.content:
## Describe the discomfort clearly
If you have discomfort in your jaw or face, explain when it occurs, how long it has been present and what seems to make it worse. Also mention any care or examinations you have already had.

## Suitability depends on an assessment
Dental or maxillofacial physiotherapy is not appropriate for every situation. The professional assesses your needs and explains whether this support may be suitable or whether another referral is needed.

## Prepare your questions
You can ask about the aim of the proposed care, what it may involve and what follow-up is being considered. The answers depend on your examination and individual situation.

urgence-dentaire-douala-que-faire.title: Dental pain in Douala: how to contact the practice
urgence-dentaire-douala-que-faire.excerpt: General guidance on asking for an assessment and knowing when to seek urgent medical help.
urgence-dentaire-douala-que-faire.author: Cabinet Sourire Serein team
urgence-dentaire-douala-que-faire.imageAlt: Illustration of a dental professional discussing tooth pain with a patient.
urgence-dentaire-douala-que-faire.content:
## Contact the practice
If dental pain is severe or getting worse, call Cabinet Sourire Serein on +237 677 87 34 42 to explain what is happening and confirm that the dental service is available. The listed hours are 24 hours a day, 7 days a week; call before travelling to confirm how you can be seen.

## While waiting for professional advice
Describe your symptoms and mention any medicines you have taken or known allergies. Do not place medicine directly on a tooth or gum, and do not take treatment that has not been recommended by a professional.

## When to seek urgent medical help
Difficulty breathing or swallowing, significant facial swelling, a serious injury or uncontrolled bleeding requires urgent medical help. This article gives general guidance and does not replace an examination or medical advice.

Comment prendre rendez-vous ?.question: How can I request an appointment?
Comment prendre rendez-vous ?.answer: Call or message us on WhatsApp at +237 677 87 34 42. You can also send a request through the contact form.

Où se trouve le cabinet ?.question: Where is the practice located?
Où se trouve le cabinet ?.answer: Cabinet Sourire Serein is located at Clinique La Bienveillance, Ancienne gare routière, Dakar, Douala, Cameroon. Use the Google Maps link on the Contact page for directions.

Quels sont les horaires affichés ?.question: What are the listed opening hours?
Quels sont les horaires affichés ?.answer: The practice hours provided are 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Call before travelling to confirm that the dental service is available, especially outside usual hours.

Quels soins dentaires sont présentés ?.question: Which dental services are listed?
Quels soins dentaires sont présentés ?.answer: The listed services include dental consultations, scaling and polishing, tooth decay care, composite restorations, maxillofacial physiotherapy, prosthetics and dental surgery. The appropriate care is determined after an assessment.

La maternité fait-elle partie du cabinet.question: Is the maternity unit part of the dental practice?
La maternité fait-elle partie du cabinet.answer: No. Maternity services belong to Clinique La Bienveillance, the partner clinic that hosts the dental practice. Contact the partner clinic directly about those services.
